name: Failed Athlete
qaNote: Reference inspected. Preserve worn green/cream varsity outfit, shorts 23, black leggings/knee brace, sneakers and basketball trophy. Review green keying, trophy continuity, limb anatomy and complete dunk contact.

result.prompt:
Create an EPIC 5-second illustrated fighting-game super finisher, portrait 9:16. Bold hand-inked outlines, rich cel shading, dynamic comic-book perspective, exaggerated scale and explosive acceleration. Reference image defines the exact character identity, face, costume, colors and props, NOT the background or initial camera crop. Preserve the illustrated character; no live-action or 3D makeover. Make a complete miniature action scene with a surprising payoff and a charismatic ending, not an idle animation with particles.
CAMERA AND COMPOSITING: cinematic camera motion is encouraged: dramatic pullbacks to reveal impossible scale, depth travel and deliberate close-ups. Establish the complete character early and return to a clear hero composition. Keep face and anatomy correct; intentional close-up crops are fine, accidental chopped limbs in a wide shot are not. The unoccupied backing remains perfectly flat pure cyan #00FFFF in EVERY shot, including close-ups. No scenery, floor plane, opaque rectangular manga panel, background gradient, vignette or full-frame whiteout. Use foreground objects and perspective to communicate distance. Large impact stars and disconnected tapered speed strokes terminate naturally on cyan instead of connecting to image borders. Warm effect colors with ink edges; no cyan/turquoise glow that will disappear under chroma key. No crowns.
TEXT: one exact move title, thick uppercase comic lettering, warm white-to-gold fill, chunky black outline and dark offset extrusion, angled forceful slam with brief overshoot and settle. Stable readable spelling, intelligently placed away from the face, no additional captions or words. A title arrival is an impact beat of its own.
SOUND: strong synchronized anticipation, accelerating whooshes, exaggerated action hits, one dominant payoff, and a short settling tail. No music, speech or narration.

Failed Athlete — One Last Shot.
IDENTITY: the exact young adult brown-skinned male athlete with short black curls and chin stubble, worn forest-green varsity jacket with cream sleeves and existing R patch, gray shirt, dog-tag necklace, distressed green shorts with existing 23 marking, black compression leggings and knee brace, worn green/cream sneakers. Preserve his small gold basketball-player trophy. Keep existing R and 23 as costume marks only; no extra captions.
0–0.7s: full-body low-angle anticipation. He looks at the little trophy with fierce determination. The tiny ball held by its gold figurine pops free, expands into a regulation-sized warm orange basketball and drops into his other hand.
0.7–2.5s: explosive comeback leap. Camera yanks backward and upward as he rockets thirty feet through the cyan void, clutching the trophy in one hand and cocking the basketball behind his head with the other. A huge freestanding orange basketball rim with a cream net hangs far above, no backboard, pole or court. He hammers the ball through in an enormous one-handed tomahawk dunk. The rim bends under the impact, a giant gold wing-shaped shield burst wraps around his shoulders, and the net whips into a long spiral. Brief readable slam contact, massive warm orange/cream impact star, powerful full-body anatomy.
2.5–3.5s: snap back to a proud full-body hero pose with the trophy raised. The distant ball contracts back into the trophy figurine's tiny hand as exact title ONE LAST SHOT slams below the athlete's face in two forceful comic lines.
3.5–5s: he basks for a beat, then the trophy figurine tilts loose on its base. He quickly straightens it with one finger and gives the viewer a stubborn confident nod. Hold the comeback shield as two finite gold arcs behind him and keep text stable. SFX: small trophy ping, explosive sneaker launch, roaring ascent, thunderous rim slam, net snap and tiny wobbling-metal rattle. No floor, crowd, scene, voice or music.
